tools.name: wallet.allCoinsInformation
tools.description:
All Coins' Information (USER_DATA)
Get information of coins (available for deposit and withdraw) for user.

tools.name: wallet.depositAddress
tools.description:
Deposit Address(supporting network) (USER_DATA)
Fetch deposit address with network.

Notes:
- If `network` is not send, return with default network of the coin.
- You can get `network` and `isDefault` in `networkList` in the response of `Get /sapi/v1/capital/config/getall (HMAC SHA256)`.
- `amount` needs to be sent if using LIGHTNING network

coin.description: `coin` refers to the parent network address format that the address is using

tools.name: wallet.depositHistory
tools.description:
Deposit History (supporting network) (USER_DATA)
Fetch deposit history.

Notes:
- Please notice the default `startTime` and `endTime` to make sure that time interval is within 0-90 days.
- If both `startTime` and `endTime` are sent, time between `startTime` and `endTime` must be less than 90 days.

status.description: 0: pending, 6: credited but cannot withdraw, 7: Wrong Deposit, 8: Waiting User confirm, 1: success

network.description: If network is not send, return with default network of the coin. You can get network and isDefault in networkList in the response of `Get /sapi/v1/capital/config/getall`

tools.name: wallet.withdrawHistory
tools.description:
Withdraw History (supporting network) (USER_DATA)
Fetch withdraw history

Notes:
- `network` may not be in the response for old withdraw.
- Please notice the default `startTime` and `endTime` to make sure that time interval is within 0-90 days.
- If both `startTime` and `endTime`are sent, time between `startTime`and `endTime`must be less than 90 days.
- If `withdrawOrderId` is sent, time between `startTime` and `endTime` must be less than 7 days.
- If `withdrawOrderId` is sent, `startTime` and `endTime` are not sent, will return last 7 days records by default.
- Maximum support `idList` number is 45.

withdrawOrderId.description:
client side id for withdrawal, if provided in POST `/sapi/v1/capital/withdraw/apply`, can be used here for
query.

idList.description: id list returned in the response of POST `/sapi/v1/capital/withdraw/apply`, separated by `,`
